description: Multi-page structured handwriting capture template for consent-based glyph extraction.

provenance_notice.title: Consent-Based Handwriting Capture
provenance_notice.body: Use only your own handwriting or handwriting from someone who has explicitly consented. Generated outputs should include provenance.

instructions: Write each labeled character inside its box without touching the border.
notes: V2 uses three pages so a practical full character set fits with multiple variants.
Page 1 contains lowercase letters, page 2 uppercase letters, and page 3 digits, punctuation, and common symbols.
The lowercase-only template_v1 remains supported for compatibility.
